MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 12
   C. 10
   D. 14

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 5
   D. 16

3. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 12

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 49

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

11. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 11

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
